notes.title: 🧠 Twice the Little Grey Cells with Detective Poirot & Royce
notes.content:
Bonjour Detectives,

What connections do a terrible crime on a peaceful cruise on the Nile and a gruesome murder in the busy streets of London have? To unveil the truth on both investigations, Hercule Poirot found an ally in private detective Jane Royce. Together, they will join forces to solve the complex case of Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile, available on September 25th!
[hr][/hr]
“When murder calls, Poirot must respond”
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45348767/a6d544f58721c1f478f4a308841ebb4e7fe3ab37.jpg
The world famous detective can’t seem to enjoy a single holiday in peace! Solving the awful murder of one of the Karnak’s passengers is sure to tickle his little grey cells. But is everything as straightforward as it seems?
[hr][/hr]
“Whatever it takes, I will bring them down”
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45348767/4b2595ab56cb1b06955294ebc85bbccfa8e62c27.jpg
Inspired by Poirot, Jane Royce has started to make a name for herself as a private detective. Rocked by a terrible tragedy, she’s determined to track down the murderer responsible for her loss no matter what, even if it means following them across the world.
[hr][/hr]
Dive into the art of Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile with the Digital Deluxe Edition, available on September 25th
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45348767/b5384d97d04507c19e8d87ed2cdcec81a26a450c.jpg
Every question must have its answer!
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: 🕊️ Discover your Next Adventure: Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy 🛩️
notes.content:
Bonjour Detectives,

On April 24th, answer the call of exploration and set off for Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy!

Embark on the quest of a lifetime aboard the Hydrafloat and explore a forgotten Latin American country to fulfill the last wishes of a late explorer. Make use of your curiosity and observational skills to solve intricate puzzles and bring back the White Birds into this mysterious land.

https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2429190/ss_87d5dc855bac62459ab5c7900c478a5b8c1f9620.1920x1080.jpg?t=1741885639

Released in 1999, Amerzone had a great impact on the adventure genre and was ahead of its time with its ecological message. This game was also the first one Benoît Sokal created before the Syberia saga.

Witness the amazing overhaul work Microids Studio Paris did to go from the 1999 original to the 2025 version:

notes.title: 🚂 Patch 3 Update 🚂
notes.content:
Bonjour Detectives,

We're thrilled to bring you the latest patch for Murder on the Orient Express, packed with fixes and improvements to enhance your gaming experience.

Here's a quick rundown of the key changes:
General Fixes:
Resolved a rare issue where the first Steam achievement might not complete. Your detective skills deserve recognition!
Enhanced French localization for an improved immersive experience.
Options Menu Enhancements:
When starting a New Game without any existing save data, the in-game voice language will automatically synchronize with the selected text language.
Updated camera settings in the main menu for a more refined experience.
When players deactivate subtitles in the Options menu, they are automatically reactivated each time the game is launched.
Chapter-Specific Improvements:
In Chapter 1, fixed a scenario where the cutscene would go away if the interaction key was spammed after inspecting Freja's dessert.
Chapter 3: Ensured that quitting the game after speaking with Ms. Moreau won't prevent unlocking a mind map node.
Chapter 7: Corrected the order of photos of ransom money when inspecting them, and fixed a text issue when inspecting Mr. MacQueen's photo.
Chapter 13: Rectified a linguistic hiccup, replacing "St Pancreas" with the correct "St Pancras" during Mr. MacQueen's dialogue.

Thank you for your continued support, detectives! Dive back into the mystery with these improvements, and keep those gray cells active. Happy investigating! 🕵️‍♂️🔍
